editorial_notes: New Thai explanation of the mathematical ideas; not a verbatim translation or redistribution of the slides.
Long private-course filename/page-range bullets omitted from reader-facing chapter per owner preference; traceability retained here.
Source E mapped to K, Brownian X to W, dividend yield kept D to avoid collision with binomial pricing q; storage cost uses kappa.
Stock/cash self-financing derivation avoids discarding terms from differentiating a varying Delta.
Physical drift mu is not set equal to r; pricing measure Q is explicitly distinguished from physical P.
Theta is derivative with respect to calendar time t; Vega and Rho displays per 1 percentage point divide unit-parameter derivatives by100.
American no-dividend Call equality is qualified by r>=0 and standard assumptions; smooth pasting qualified by regular diffusion boundary.
All worked numerical results and native charts are newly computed hypothetical examples; no empirical market prices.
No original figure, logo, source screenshot, or unverified metadata attribution is reproduced.

hedge.funding: Cash accrues exp(r*dt); rebalancing funded by same bank account; no external cash and no expiry rebalance.
hedge.caveat: More steps need not reduce absolute hedge error on every individual path. Sampling error, discrete hedge error and model error are distinct.
